Its oracle helpers seo-new-coverage-oracle.mjs and seo-guest-clipboard.mjs match the product-source versions byte-for-byte.

The workflow source scripts/hosted-seo-route.mjs at f653 adds fsync plus atomic rename progress persistence, and tests include a child SIGTERM seam. This native run completed normally; it does not independently prove interruption durability.

A normal successful receipt does not exercise interruption durability, and this review does not close D183.
The run proves this controlled ARM lane executed successfully; it does not establish an architecture cause for separate Intel admission failures.
